# Test Red-DiscordBot cogs via downloader

Installs and validates cogs through Red's downloader cog using a temporary git repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | ✅ | — | Discord bot token used when starting Red-DiscordBot |
| `cog_paths` | ❌ | — | Comma-separated list of cog directories, empty takes all with info.json in repo |
| `repo_name` | ❌ | test-repo | Name assigned to the temporary downloader repository |
| `repo_url` | ❌ | — | Optional repository URL; leave empty to use the temporary local repo |
| `repo_branch` | ❌ | — | Optional branch name to use when cloning the repository |
| `rpc_port` | ❌ | 6133 | Port Red-DiscordBot RPC server listens on |

<!-- END AUTOGENERATED:ACTION-DOC -->
